entities.title: A font of our own
entities.summary: The 8×8 character set is drawn for this project; it is not the Sinclair ROM font.
entities.context: The Spectrum look needs an 8×8 font, and the machine's own ROM font is someone else's work.
entities.decision: Glyphs in the Spectrum's style, drawn for this project as rows of # and . in font.ts: capitals and digits in rows 1–6 and columns 1–6, lower case with a five-row x-height and descenders in row 7.
entities.rationale: Keeps the look without copying the ROM; PROVENANCE.md keeps it as the remake's own work.

entities.title: Platform keys never reach the game
entities.summary: A key the platform reserves, such as M for sound, never answers a prompt.
entities.context: In the original every key answers a prompt; a sound key that also counted as "no" or "next" would change the input semantics.
entities.decision: Input.reserve takes a key out of play: it runs its action and is not passed on, except while a name is typed, when M is a letter.
entities.rationale: The engine's input stays exactly RULES §15.1's, and parity holds (GDD §13, the M-key risk).
entities.decidedBy: Spec role, from the designer's questions (GDD §14)
